company.name: Webflow
company.shortDescription: Webflow is a visual web design platform, CMS, and hosting provider for building production websites and prototypes.
company.description:
Webflow is the first design and hosting platform built from the ground up for the mobile age.

Webflow allows the user to design, build, and launch responsive websites visually, while writing clean, semantic code. It is the only hosted service that allows designers to create websites that work on every device, and push it to live production without a developer.

Webflow is a visual web design platform, CMS, and hosting provider for building production websites and prototypes. Webflow offers a way to design, build, and launch websites visually without coding.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $400,000, or 0.12% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $350,000,000 to $4,000,000,000, a 11.43x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
